card.name: Just before anesthesia/analgesia words
card.fires_on: Marks the spot just before the model writes 'ana'/'anal' (analgesic, anesthesia, anxiolysis). It fires on 'an', 'at', '/an' or a space right before such a word. It also fires on digits in dose tables.
